text.tspan: Front Door shifts traffic to the healthy region's AKS stamp without manual steps
Active-active AKS in two regions with hub-spoke networking
Users connect to the global Front Door
Front Door routes each request to the
Application Gateway forwards to the ingress
Cluster egress is forced through the hub
Through the firewall, nodes pull images from
the geo-replicated registry and send logs to
